business_listing_source_owner.name: business_listing_source_owner
business_listing_source_owner.value: (listing_source = 'member' AND owner_user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (listing_source = 'curated' AND owner_user_id IS NULL AND ownership_status = 'unverified' AND curation_source_url IS NOT NULL)

business_destination_required.name: business_destination_required
business_destination_required.value: website_url IS NOT NULL OR app_store_url IS NOT NULL OR play_store_url IS NOT NULL OR social_url IS NOT NULL OR contact_url IS NOT NULL

business_physical_location_required.name: business_physical_location_required
business_physical_location_required.value: operation_mode = 'online' OR (location IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(location)) >= 2)

content_report_open_review_unique.name: content_report_open_review_unique
content_report_open_review_unique.where: status = 'open' AND review_id IS NOT NULL

content_report_details_length.name: content_report_details_length
content_report_details_length.value: details IS NULL OR length(trim(details)) BETWEEN 10 AND 1000

email_outbox_lock_valid.name: email_outbox_lock_valid
email_outbox_lock_valid.value: ("email_outbox"."status" = 'sending' and "email_outbox"."locked_at" is not null and "email_outbox"."lock_token" is not null) or ("email_outbox"."status" <> 'sending' and "email_outbox"."locked_at" is null and "email_outbox"."lock_token" is null)
